contentList.content: You gain one Sneak Attack charge, allowing you to deal additional damage to your enemies each turn.
You gain three Luck Points, allowing you to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your rolls.
The remaining amount of times that you may utilize your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> this turn.
<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> will not activate when attacking this creature until they have started their next turn.

Deal an extra [1] damage to a creature you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> against. You must be unarmed or wielding a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse Weapon</LSTag> in order to trigger Sneak Attack.

Deal an extra [1] damage to a creature you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> against. You must be unarmed or wielding a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse Weapon</LSTag> in order to trigger Sneak Attack.
You can also Sneak Attack creatures <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FLANKED">Threatened</LSTag> by adjacent allies provided you aren't attacking with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.
Spend one of your Lucky dice to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on your next <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Check</LSTag>. This effect can be toggled at any time.

Spend one of your Lucky dice to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> or force enemies to attack you with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>. Once per turn, the first time you deal or take damage will consume one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag>.

Gain the ability to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Dash">Dash</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Disengage">Disengage</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Hide">Hide</LSTag> as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>. This effect can be toggled at any time.

All unarmed based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> that you make receive a bonus equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Dexterity Modifier</LSTag>. In addition, you gain the ability to throw a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_SmokeBomb">Smoke Bomb</LSTag> once per turn.
Throw a bomb which can <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blind</LSTag> creatures and conceal your position.
While in combat, you have a 50% chance to restore one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag> at the beginning of your turns.
You may utilize your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> two times per turn.

When an enemy makes a successful <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against you, use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> in order to force the attack to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="OFF_BALANCED_CRITICAL_MISS">Critically Miss</LSTag>. This Reaction may not be used if your enemy rolls a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.

When an enemy makes a successful <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against you, force the attack to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="OFF_BALANCED_CRITICAL_MISS">Critically Miss</LSTag>. Cannot be used if your enemy rolls a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.
You may utilize your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> three times per turn.

As quick with a spell as you are with a lockpick, your illusions and enchantments keep opponents on the back foot.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage

<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> can trigger when casting <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrips</LSTag> and Spells. Additionally, casting Cantrips and Spells while <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Hide">Hidden</LSTag> will not break <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Stealth</LSTag>.

Deal an extra [1] to a creature you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> against. If casting a <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> or Spell, Sneak Attack will instead deal Force damage, and Advantage is not required. You must be unarmed or wielding a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse Weapon</LSTag> in order to trigger Sneak Attack.

Grant yourself or another creature <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisibility</LSTag>. For as long as you maintain <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag>, your target will become Invisible at the start of each of their turns while in combat. They may also become Invisible outside of combat if starting their turn while <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Sneaking</LSTag>.

Affected creature will become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisibility</LSTag> at the start of each turn while in combat. They may also become Invisible outside of combat if starting their turn while <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Sneaking</LSTag>.
<LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> made against you are rolled with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>. Upon being damaged, this effect is disabled for three turns.
Affected creature is forcing all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> made against them to be rolled with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.
Affected creature cannot benefit from <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="TrickoftheLight">Trick of the Light</LSTag>.
Once per turn, casting a Spell while <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag> will not consume a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag>.
Once per turn, you may teleport as a free action through the use of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ArcaneAmbush">Arcane Ambush</LSTag>.
Surrounded by arcane energy, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.
At the start of each of your turns, if visible, you become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag> until the end of your turn.

You prefer to deal sublime punishment to a single foe at a time - not in a duel, mind, because a duel implies chivalry, and you're too busy getting the job done for honour.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

You immediately restore your Action and Bonus Action at the beginning of combat and have Advantage when attacking targets who have not taken a turn yet.

Outside of combat, while Sneaking or Invisible, any successful Attack Roll you make deals an additonal 12 damage multiplied by your levels in Rogue. The type of damage dealt is the same as your main-hand melee weapon.

Additionally, you gain the ability to Assassinate a target of your choice, once per combat.
Once per combat, and while <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Sneaking</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag>, deal significantly more damage to a target.

Every three turns while in combat, you gain an <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="AssassinsMark">Assassin's Mark</LSTag>. You may use these to trigger <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Assassinate">Assassinate</LSTag> when dealing damage to an enemy while in combat. This effect can be toggled at any time.
Affected creature will gain an <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="AssassinsMark">Assassin's Mark</LSTag> upon accruing three stacks of this condition.
Affected creature may trigger <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Assassinate">Assassinate</LSTag> when dealing damage with a weapon.

Each turn while in combat, you have a 33% chance to gain an Assassin's Mark.

Expend an Assassin's Mark to trigger Assassinate on your next instance of damage. This effect can be toggled at any time.
Used to trigger <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_Assassinate">Assassinate</LSTag> when dealing damage.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Sneaking</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag>, dealing damage to a target leaves it unable to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ALERTED">Alerted</LSTag> until the end of your turn.
Affected creature is unable to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ALERTED">Alerted</LSTag>.
All <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> outside of combat are considered to be <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag>.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Sneaking</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag>, you have a chance to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PARALYZED">Paralyze</LSTag> your target upon dealing damage in combat. If your target is not currently in combat, they are immediately Paralyzed.
Dealing damage to a target with less than 20% of its total <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> instantly kills them.

With gauntlet and dagger in hand, you bend the battlefield to your will, dragging enemies into reach, striking from impossible angles, and stealing their final moments for yourself.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage

Your weapons and unarmed damage may scale using your Dexterity, rather than your Strength. This can be toggled at any time.

Additionally, while unarmed or dealing damage with a dagger in your main-hand, you gain Advantage on all Attack Rolls.

Gain the ability to throw a grappling hook, pulling a creature [1] closer to you and dealing damage equal to your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> in the process. In addition, when making a melee based unarmed <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, you deal an additional [2].
Throw a grapling hook and pull a creature [1] closer to you, dealing damage equal to your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> in the process.

After having used <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GetOverHere">Get Over Here</LSTag> to pull a creature closer, you may expend a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag> to kick them, pushing them backward by [1] and knocking them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.

After having used <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GetOverHere">Get Over Here</LSTag> to pull a creature closer, kick them, pushing them backward by [1] and knocking them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.

Gain the ability to teleport up to [1], potentially <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinding</LSTag> enemies within [2] of where you land. In addition, after damaging an enemy with a weapon or a melee-based unarmed <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, you may immediately follow up with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GetOverHere">Get Over Here</LSTag> if they are farther than [3] away.
Teleport up to [1], potentially <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinding</LSTag> enemies within [2] of where you land.

After damaging an enemy who is farther than [1] away with a weapon or a melee-based unarmed <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, throw a grapling hook and pull them [2] closer to you, dealing damage equal to your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> in the process.

Gain the ability to attack all creatures within [1], pushing them backward by [2] and knocking them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>. You may also do so after you successfully avoid an enemies melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
Attack all creatures within [1], pushing them backward by [2] and knocking them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.

After having avoided an enemies melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, attack all creatures within [1], pushing them backward by [2] and knocking them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.

Upon killing a creature, you store their essence as sand in an hourglass. After having killed three creatures, you may use their sand in order to restore your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Points</LSTag>.
Expend your currently held sand in order to restore your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Points</LSTag>.

Affected creature is storing sand obtained from killing enemies. Upon gaining three stacks of this condition, they will be able to fully restore their <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Points</LSTag>.

You have learned to turn flesh into a vessel for ruin. With measured tinctures and precise brews, you mark vital points and allow your toxins to do the rest.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage

Upon dealing Poison damage to an enemy, you afflict them with one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TOXICITY">Cursed Toxicity</LSTag>. Stacks of Toxicity can then be <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Toxicity_Container">Detonated</LSTag> in order to trigger various effects. In addition, your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> deals Poison damage.

Deal an extra [1] damage to a creature you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> against. You must be unarmed or wielding a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse Weapon</LSTag> in order to trigger Sneak Attack.

Affected creature is afflicted with a cursed toxin, waiting to be activated. The curse renders them unable to utilize their armours physical Damage Reduction.

Removed at the end of combat.
Detonate an enemies <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TOXICITY">Cursed Toxicity</LSTag> stacks for various effects.

Wrack your enemies sense of balance, causing them to become Critically Off-Balanced.

Your target must have at least three stacks of Cursed Toxicity.

Debilitate an enemies ability to move, leaving them Slowed.

Your target must have at least three stacks of Cursed Toxicity.

Overstimulate the toxin within your target, Poisoning them.

Your target must have at least three stacks of Cursed Toxicity.
When dealing damage to an enemy, you deal additional Poison damage equal to your levels in Rogue. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

Gain the ability to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_DetonateToxicity">Detonate</LSTag> five stacks of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TOXICITY">Cursed Toxicity</LSTag> at once in order to trigger one of three new effects.

Wreck your targets sense of direction, Confusing them.

Your target must have at least five stacks of Cursed Toxicity.

Debilitate an enemies ability to speak, Muting them and breaking their Concentration.

Your target must have at least five stacks of Cursed Toxicity.

Cause your targets poisoned blood to boil, afflicting them with a potent Bufotoxin.

Your target must have at least five stacks of Cursed Toxicity.
Upon applying a coating to your weapon, it will persist until your next <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">Long Rest</LSTag>.

Gain the ability to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_DetonateToxicity">Detonate</LSTag> seven stacks of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TOXICITY">Cursed Toxicity</LSTag> at once in order to trigger one of three new effects.

Ravage your targets senses of pain, Paralyzing them.

Your target must have at least seven stacks of Cursed Toxicity.

Debilitate your target with an intense sickness, Nauseating them.

Your target must have at least seven stacks of Cursed Toxicity.

Cause the toxins within your target to erupt as a poisonous cloud, instantly dealing Poison damage to them and all enemies within [1] of them equal to your Proficiency Bonus multiplied by 12.

Your target must have at least seven stacks of Cursed Toxicity.

Upon <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_DetonateToxicity">Detonating</LSTag> a toxin on your target, you now strip them of their <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="LOCKDOWN_CONDITION_DESCRIPTION">Lockdown Immunity</LSTag>.

Equally as intelligent as you are cunning, you can talk your way through any situation. And when blades are drawn, you can speak that language, too.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Tank

Gain a bonus to your Initiative and Charisma based Skill Checks equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

In addition, Sneak Attack may now trigger at any time provided you don't have Disadvantage when making the Attack Roll and the target is not Alerted.
Deal an extra [1] damage to a creature. You must be unarmed or wielding a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse Weapon</LSTag> in order to trigger Sneak Attack.

Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DirtyTrick_Disarm">Disarming Feint</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DirtyTrick_Blind">Blinding Powder</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DirtyTrick_Vicious">Mocking Tone</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DirtyTrick_Panache">Provocative Challenge</LSTag>.

Toss a handful of powder at a target, dealing damage equal to your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> and possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinding</LSTag> them.
Attack a target and possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DISARMED">Disarm</LSTag> them.
Dismantle a creatures confidence, causing their next <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> to be made with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.

Roll a Persuasion based <LSTag Tooltip="SkillCheck">Skill Check</LSTag> to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PANACHE">Provoke</LSTag> all nearby creatures. Each creature will roll an Insight based Skill Check to resist your provocation. While active, you are considered to be a preferred target.
Affected creature has a -5 penalty on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> when not attacking the creature who provoked them.

Gain status based immunity to falling <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag> or being <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DISARMED">Disarmed</LSTag>. In addition, you now always succeed Dexterity based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Gain the ability to immediately retaliate upon avoiding damage, spending a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag> in order to make an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against your aggressor.
Immediately retaliate upon avoiding damage and make an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against your aggressor.

Each of your Mercenary abilities are are improved, allowing you to target an additional creature. <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DirtyTrick_Panache">Provocative Challenge</LSTag> now affects all humanoids in a [1] radius.
Summon the explosive power of mercenary cannons fired indiscriminately, blanketing random areas of the battlefield with explosives.

Your mastery of evasion makes the antics of a scoundrel second nature.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Support

You always start combat with all of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Points</LSTag>. When an enemy is about to hit you, you can use a Luck Point in order to cause it to miss. When you are about to miss an enemy, you can use a Luck Point in order to cause your attack to hit.
When an enemy is about to hit you, use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag> in order to cause it to miss.
When you are about to miss an enemy, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag> in order to cause it to hit.

Once per turn, you can use any of your Common Actions without expending an <LSTag Tooltip="Action">Action</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>. This effect can be toggled at any time.

Common Actions include <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Dash">Dashing</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Disengage">Disengaging</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Help">Helping</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Hide">Hiding</LSTag>, making <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_ImprovisedWeapon">Improvised Attacks</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_Throw">Throwing</LSTag> objects or creatures, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Dip">Dipping</LSTag> weapons, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_Jump">Jumping</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Shove">Shoving</LSTag>.

Gain status immunity to all physical effects which would impede your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> or sight. Upon <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Sneaking</LSTag> or becoming <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag>, you create a small <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FogCloud">Fog Cloud</LSTag> around yourself. This can be toggled at any time.

When you roll a Critical Miss against an enemy, or when an enemy rolls a Critical Miss against you, all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> you make until ending your turn will be rolled as a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>.
Affected creature's <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> will all be <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag> until the end of their turn.
<LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="LuckyToss">Lucky Toss</LSTag> now restores a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag> every turn.
The first <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> you roll each turn will always deal the maximum damage possible.

A single wound is all you require. What begins as a scratch soon festers into ruin as virulent corruption courses through your victim.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> deals Acid damage. In addition, when dealing damage to an enemy, you deal additional Acid damage equal to your levels in Rogue. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.

Deal an extra [1] damage to a creature you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> against. You must be unarmed or wielding a <LSTag Tooltip="Finesse">Finesse Weapon</LSTag> in order to trigger Sneak Attack.
Upon triggering <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> on an enemy, they immediately become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CORRODED">Corroded</LSTag> for one turn.
Dealing Acid damage applies one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ACID">Acid</LSTag>.
Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag> now deals damage to all enemies in a [1] radius.

When targeting a creature coated in <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ACID">Acid</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CORRODED">Corrosion</LSTag>, you make all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and Damage Rolls with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

When dealing physical damage to a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CORRODED">Corroded</LSTag> enemy with your main-hand weapon, you deal additional damage equal to your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attack</LSTag>. Upon dealing this bonus damage, Corrosion is immediately removed from your target.

Covert planning plays the tune to a dance of masterful subterfuge.
Every step disguising a calculated gambit.

Gain Cunning Fang, allowing you to throw a dagger. The damage of Cunning Fang increases as you level, and may trigger Sneak Attack.

While Nimble Movement is toggled on, you may instead throw the dagger as a Bonus Action.

Throw a dagger at a target. This action is considered to be a melee based Attack Roll.

While Nimble Movement is toggled on, you may instead throw the dagger as a Bonus Action.
When you roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, roll an additional damage die.

Upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, you immediately <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Dash">Dash</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Disengage">Disengage</LSTag>.
Once per turn, you may <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Hide">Hide</LSTag> without expending any resources.
Affected creature may <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Hide">Hide</LSTag> once without expending any resources.
Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING">Sneaking</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">Invisible</LSTag>, the number needed in order to roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> is reduced by one.

Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SneakAttack">Sneak Attacks</LSTag> halve your targets <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> and prevent them from using <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reactions</LSTag>.
Affected creature has had their <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> halved and cannot <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">React</LSTag>.

Summon an illusory decoy which erupts into fireworks upon vanishing, Blinding any nearby creatures.

This Cantrip may be cast while Silenced or Muted and will not break Stealth.
You permanently benefit from the effects of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FREEDOM_OF_MOVEMENT_ROGUE">Freedom of Movement</LSTag>.
While obscured in shadow, your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> increases by two.

Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Persuasion">Persuasion</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>. In addition, each turn you have a 50% chance to recover one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="LuckPoint">Luck Point</LSTag>.

When an enemy fails a <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attack</LSTag> against you, you may spend your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> in order to make one against them in retaliation, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinding</LSTag> them for the rest of their turn in the process.
